snippet.title: My Life: Riding Stables 2. Game for Switch, PS4 & PS5. Official English trailer.
snippet.description: Put your heart and soul into looking after the well-being of your beloved four-legged friends on a beautiful stud farm, which you can expand over the course of the game. Climb into the saddle and enjoy challenging training sessions, fantastic tournaments, and relaxed rides through the countryside.
